The château, its gardens and the tours, in pictures.

“

I have done a little good; that is my best work.

Voltaire, Epistle to Horace (1772)

Voltaire wrote these words at Ferney, thinking of the village he had revived: houses, watchmaking workshops, a church and a fountain.

Ready to meet Voltaire?

Tell me who you are and what you would enjoy, and I’ll suggest a tour made for you.
